newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's MEB rates Egis as 'buy'.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's MEB rates Egis as 'buy'.

text.p: Hungarian securities house MEB (formerly called AFI Broker) said it rated shares in Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Egis Gyogyszergyar Rt as 'buy', saying it was undervalued at current price.

"We recommend Egis shares to buy because we regard them undervalued at its current price (of 11,050 forints at Monday's close) compared to both its competitors and to its own performance," analyst Zoltan Kurali said in a company research.
The analyst said that Egis had substantial growth potential, while its planned diversified export structure will significantly reduce the company's risks on foreign markets.
Possible difficulties on the domestic market, stemming from increasing competition, will be offset by the expected dynamic growth of exports, he said.
At a news conference on Monday Egis said it expected its exports to play an increasing role in the future.
In 1996 domestic sales accounted for 54.9 percent of Egis's total sales and this ratio will drop to 52 percent in 1997 and to below 50 percent in 1998, Egis said.
